listening.title: Suggesting a bigger plan before the renewal

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: Thanks for your time, Minh. Your renewal date is in March, so let us plan early.

lines.speaker: Minh (IT Manager)
lines.text: Sure. Honestly, the current plan works well for us.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: I am glad. But I noticed something in your usage report.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: Your seat count is thirty, but about forty people use the system every day.

lines.speaker: Minh (IT Manager)
lines.text: That is true. Some people share one account, and it is not ideal.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: You can buy an additional licence for each person, or move to the next tier.

lines.speaker: Minh (IT Manager)
lines.text: What is the difference between those two options?

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: The next tier gives you fifty seats, reporting tools and priority support.

lines.speaker: Minh (IT Manager)
lines.text: That sounds interesting, but my director will ask about the cost.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: Of course. I will send the return on investment over twelve months.

lines.speaker: Minh (IT Manager)
lines.text: Please do. If the long-term value is clear, we can discuss it in January.
